notes.title: 2.0 Alpha
notes.content:
Version 2.0 Alpha Now Live!

We’ve completely rebuilt the game from the ground up based on community feedback following the 1.0 launch. This update marks the beginning of a brand new era for the game — faster, smoother, and more refined across the board.

Key Changes:

Full overhaul of core systems and gameplay

Improved visuals, UI, and performance

New mechanics and design improvements throughout

More responsive controls and streamlined interactions

Two Versions Available:

2.0 Alpha (Default): The new version, rebuilt from scratch

1.0 Vanilla: The original launch version, still available on a Steam beta branch

How to Access 1.0 Vanilla:

Right-click the game in your Steam Library and choose Properties

Go to the Betas tab

Select the "1.0 Vanilla" branch

We're still actively developing 2.0, but it's already a big leap forward. Your feedback is more important than ever — thank you for being part of this journey!
